HarnessChoice.note: Horizontal orientation, three cards with icons and descriptions; selected card carries border-special plus the filled Check badge, unselected carry the empty ring. Icons promote to foreground only on the selected card, as the source specifies.

Vertical.note: orientation=vertical stacks full-width cards with the selection badge top-right; clearly distinct from the horizontal cells.

LabelsOnly.note: Label+icon cards with no description render at the compact height — the description-less branch of the card body.

WithDisabled.note: Third option renders at 50% with pointer events off while the selected card keeps border-special; disabled state is unambiguous.
